verses.2446: ṣalli rabbī ʿalā shafīʿi l-barāyā maʿa l-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi ʾahli l-wafāʾi
verses.2447: yā ʿadhūlī famā lihindi naṣību fī fuʾādī daʿnī walā maylāʾi
verses.2448: ʾinna ḥubbī limithlihinna ḥarāmu faʾariḥnī ḥāliyā ghayru khafāʾi
verses.2449: qad saqānī kaʾasa l-maḥabbahi rabbī min fuyūḍāti khātimi l-ʾawliyāʾi
verses.2450: yā ʿadhūlī fāṣrif ʿinānaka ʿannī wāṭlubi l-ghayra ʾinnanī fī fanāʾi
verses.2451: khamru shawqi man dhāqahu lā yubālī man ʾatā lāʾimā bidūni mtirāʾi
verses.2452: ḥubbu ṭaha lil-mudhnibīna najātu wa ʾamānu min hawli yawmi lliqāʾi
verses.2453: ʾinna ḥubba n-nabiyyī khālaṭa laḥmī wa ʿiẓāmī wa l-mukhkha dūna riyāʾī
verses.2454: hāja shawqī liḥubbi khayri l-barāyā maẓhari lluṭfi ʾakrami l-kuramāʾi
verses.2455: sayyidi l-mursalīna hādī l-barāyā liriḍā llāhi wad-di z-zahrāʾi
verses.2456: ḥubbu ṭaha n-nabiyyī farḍī wanaflī wa sharābī wa munyatī wa ghidhāʾī
verses.2457: huwa baytī wa zamzamī wa ḥaṭīmī wa maqāmī wa marwatī wa ṣafāʾī
verses.2458: ḥaramī mashʿarī mazābī wa ruknī ḥajarī qiblatī wa ghāru ḥirāʾī
verses.2459: yathrabī qubbatī qubāyā baqīʿī ʾuḥudī ṣuffatī wa kanzu ghināʾī
verses.2460: huwa ḥillī masʿāyā bābu salāmī wa maṭāfī wa biʾiru gharsī wa māʾī
verses.2461: yā ʿadhūlī fī ḥubbi ʾaḥmada jahlā wābnihi shaykhinā t-tijānī rajāʾī
verses.2462: lā talumnī faʾinnanī fī huyāmi lawmu mithlī ẓulmu ladā l-ʿuqalāʾi
verses.2463: sayyida r-rusli khātima l-ʾanbiyāʾi muṣṭafā llāhi ṣafwata l-ʾaṣfiyāʾi
verses.2464: mafzaʿa n-nāsi ʿinda yawmi zdiḥāmi wa shafīʿa l-ʿuṣāti yawma l-jazāʾi
verses.2465: faṣalātu mina l-ʾilāhi taʿālā wasalāmu ʿalayka dūna nqiḍāʾi
verses.2466: wa ʿalā ʾālika l-kirāmi wa ṣaḥbi laka dāʿī l-warā ʾilā dhī l-ʿalāʾi
verses.2467: shhadū lī biʾannanī sayyida l-khalqi muḥibbu lakum warabbi s-samāʾi
verses.2468: fāqbalū lī maḥabbatī yā thimālī wa malādhī fī shiddati wa rakhāʾi
verses.2469: fawarabbī mālī rajāʾu siwākum wa ʾabī l-fayḍi khātimi l-ʾawliyāʾi
verses.2470: kun liʿabdi l-ʿazīzi ʿabdika hadhā ḥāmiyā nāṣirā ʿalā l-ʾaʿdāʾi
verses.2471: fasarīʿā ʾaghithhu min miḥnati d-dahri wa min kulli fitnati nakrāʾi
verses.2472: mā lahu munqidhu siwāka mina l-ʾaʿdāʾi ʾanqidhhu munqidha l-ghurabāʾi
verses.2473: laysa yarjū baʿda l-ʾilāhi siwākum wa mumiddi l-ʾaqṭābi wa n-nujabāʾi
verses.2474: ṣāḥibi l-khatmi tāju kulli waliyyi wa mufīḍa l-ʾasrāri wa n-naʿmāʾi
verses.2475: ʿiwajī qawwimū bijūdika ṭaha wāslukū bī masālika l-ʾatqiyāʾi
verses.2476: yā ghiyāthī madadtu yāʾī wa dālī rājiyā minkumu qubūla duʿāʾī
verses.2477: wamamātī ʿalā ṭarīqati shaykhī ṣāḥibi l-khatmi nuqbahi n-nuqabāʾi
verses.2478: rḥamūnī khayra l-bariyyati yā man khaṣṣahu llāhu rabbunā billiwāʾi
verses.2479: ʾinna shawqī fīkum labaḥru ʿamīqu qaʿruhu lā yuqāsu dūna mirāʾi
verses.2480: yā rasūla l-ʾilahi ʿabduka hadhā wākfihi ʿumrahu jamīʿa l-balāʾi
verses.2481: wa lahu tammiman jamīʿa l-ʾamānī fī salāmi wa ṣiḥḥahi wa rtiqāʾi
verses.2482: wa qihi yā rabbi kulla makhūfi min ʿaduwwi wa mubʿidi dhī ʿtidāʾi
verses.2483: yā ʾilāhī wājʿalhu ḥubbā ṣadūqā lir-rasūli ʾāthārahu dhā qtifāʾi
verses.2484: wa biḥḥubi n-nabiyyī qalbiyā nawwir wājʿalannī bihadyihi dhā htidāʾi
verses.2485: wa biʾayyī dh-dhikri l-ḥakīmi ʾilāhī fāshfi dāʾī rabbī wa ʾayyī sh-shifāʾi
verses.2486: ʾaddi rabbī ḥuqūqa ghayrika ʿannī raḥmaha minka yā ʿalī dhā l-baqāʾi
verses.2487: yā ʾilāhī famā lakum min ḥuqūqi fāʿfu ʿannī yā ʾalṭafa lluṭafāʾi
verses.2488: rabbi ʿāmil bil-faḍli ʿabdaka hadhā wa biʿafwi wa lluṭfi yā dhā ṣ-ṣafāʾi
verses.2489: qad ʾatākum mustarḥimā mustaghīthā bika yā rabbi ʾaʿẓama l-ʿuẓamāʾi
verses.2490: yā shafīʿī ʾilayka wajjahtu wajhī rājiyā minkumu shifā kulli dāʾi
verses.2491: walaʾanta ṭ-ṭabību ḥaqqā liʿabdi dāʾimā fī taḍarruʿi wa bukāʾi
verses.2492: ʾinna madḥa n-nabiyyī khayru ʿilāji ʿālijwunī bihi fafīhi shifāʾī
verses.2493: yā ṭabība l-qulūbi ʿabduka hadhā jāʾakum kay yanāla khayra dawāʾi
verses.2494: ʾantumu l-bābu lil-ʿibādi ʾilā llāhi jamīʿā ḥaqqā bilā stithnāʾi
verses.2495: kayfa lā wājtabāka mawlāka ḥubbā khaṣṣakum fī l-kitābi khayra thanāʾi
verses.2496: sūrata n-nūni fābḥathan satarā mā qultuhu wāḍiḥā kashamsi ḍ-ḍuḥāʾi
verses.2497: sayyidī yā ʾabā l-batūli rajāʾī lakabīru fīkum ḥimā ḍ-ḍuʿafāʾi
verses.2498: hadhihi sayyidī hadiyyatu ʿabdi mudhnibu khāʾifu ʿaẓīmu r-rajāʾi
verses.2499: fīkumu sayyidī walaysa yakhību mustajīru ʾatāka baḥra l-ʿaṭāʾi
verses.2500: fadhunūbī yā sayyidī ʾaghraqatnī minka ʾarjūlkhalāṣa min dhī l-balāʾi
verses.2501: yā ṭabība l-qulūbi yā khayra shāfi fāshfinī yā ṭabību taʿlamu dāʾī
verses.2502: walaʾanta ṭ-ṭabību mālī siwākum dāwi dāʾī bisayyidi l-ʾanbiyāʾi
verses.2503: yā ʾilāhī ʾin lam takun lī ṭabībā wa ʾilā man ʾarjū siwāka dawāʾī
verses.2504: yā mujībā nidāʾa ʿabdi daʿāhu mustaghīthā ʾajib mughīthī nidāʾī
verses.2505: yā ʾilāhī bārik liʿabdika hadhā ʿumrahu bin-nabiyyī dhā qtidāʾi
verses.2506: wa binūri l-qurʾāni qalbiyā nawwir qalbahu najjihi mina l-kibriyāʾi
verses.2507: qad madadnā yada s-suʾāli ʾilaykum ʾaʿṭinā mā narūmu yā dhā s-sanāʾi
